output.name: write
output.purpose: Produce the requested human-facing draft with grounded facts, coherent progression and preserved author meaning.

criteria.description: Preserve author meaning and distinguish facts/quotes from unsupported material.
Read the complete draft for continuity, grounded concepts and the reader task.
Review actual text for purpose and applicable anti-slop criteria; publication needs its real scope.

limits: Mechanical verification checks recorded facts and actual retained bytes; a recorded semantic inspection is not authenticated judgment.
Compilation and fixture success do not prove complete semantic workflow performance or provider/native-host activation.
The deterministic core checks source/evidence boundaries. It does not generate or authenticate the quality of an article; actual composition and text inspection remain required.
